Ask HN: What is the main bottleneck facing Agentic AI today?
items.summary: Hey guys, today I read a statistic that showed that Agentic traffic surpassed human traffic on the internet and that statistic was very shocking to me. At the same time I saw another statistic that showed only 10% of agents built, actually get into production. These two statistics seemed ironic to me. So I wondered to myself what is the major bottleneck that is causing a lot of the agents that are being built not get into production and what is the infrastructure missing to make Agentic traffic to thrive even more?

Show HN: Junior – an open-source AI junior engineer that runs on your Mac
items.summary: Hi HN, I'm Samar, a software engineer. I built Junior because I was spending more time fixing CI issues, babysitting PRs and resolving merge conflicts. I thought maybe i should automate all of it, and that's why I started building Junior. Junior is an agent that runs locally on macOS and picks up that kind of work. It connects with my Linear, Slack, Github etc and autopicks work for himself. It works on it and shares a report for me to review. It's open source under. I'd love feedback, especially on the permission model and how autonomous should it work. Happy to answer anything.
